briefdescription.para: getAnalysisUsage - This function should be overriden by passes that need analysis information to do their job.

detaileddescription.para: If a pass specifies that it uses a particular analysis result to this function, it can then use the getAnalysis<AnalysisType>() function, below.

briefdescription.para: runOnMachineFunction - Loop over all of the basic blocks, transforming FP register references into FP stack references.
getPassName - Return a nice clean name for a pass.

detaileddescription.para: This usually implemented in terms of the name that is registered by one of the Registration templates, but can be overloaded directly.

briefdescription.para: bundleCFG - Scan all the basic blocks to determine consistent live-in and live-out sets for the FP registers.

detaileddescription.para: Consistent means that the set of registers live-out from a block is identical to the live-in set of all successors. This is not enforced by the normal live-in lists since registers may be implicitly defined, or not used by all successors.

briefdescription.para: setupBlockStack - Use the live bundles to set up our model of the stack to match predecessors' live out stack.
finishBlockStack - Revive live-outs that are implicitly defined out of MBB.

detaileddescription.para: Shuffle live registers to match the expected fixed stack of any predecessors, and ensure that all predecessors are expecting the same stack.

briefdescription.para: getSlot - Return the stack slot number a particular register number is in.
isLive - Is RegNo currently live in the stack?
getStackEntry - Return the X86::FP<n> register in register ST(i).
getSTReg - Return the X86::ST(i) register which contains the specified FP<RegNo> register.
popStackAfter - Pop the current value off of the top of the FP stack after the specified instruction.

detaileddescription.para: This attempts to be sneaky and combine the pop into the instruction itself if possible. The iterator is left pointing to the last instruction, be it a new pop instruction inserted, or the old instruction if it was modified in place.

briefdescription.para: freeStackSlotAfter - Free the specified register from the register stack, so that it is no longer in a register.

detaileddescription.para: If the register is currently at the top of the stack, we just pop the current instruction, otherwise we store the current top-of-stack into the specified slot, then pop the top of stack.

briefdescription.para: freeStackSlotBefore - Just the pop, no folding.

detaileddescription.para: freeStackSlotBefore - Free the specified register without trying any folding.

briefdescription.para: Adjust the live registers to be the set in Mask.

detaileddescription.para: adjustLiveRegs - Kill and revive registers such that exactly the FP registers with a bit in Mask are live.

briefdescription.para: Shuffle the top FixCount stack entries such that FP reg FixStack[0] is st(0), FP reg FixStack[1] is st(1) etc.

detaileddescription.para: shuffleStackTop - emit fxch instructions before I to shuffle the top FixCount entries into the order given by FixStack.

briefdescription.para: handleZeroArgFP - ST(0) = fld0 ST(0) = flds <mem>
handleOneArgFP - fst <mem>, ST(0)
handleOneArgFPRW: Handle instructions that read from the top of stack and replace the value with a newly computed value.

detaileddescription.para: These instructions may have non-fp operands after their FP operands.
Examples: R1 = fchs R2 R1 = fadd R2, [mem]

briefdescription.para: handleTwoArgFP - Handle instructions like FADD and friends which are virtual instructions which need to be simplified and possibly transformed.

detaileddescription.para: Result: ST(0) = fsub ST(0), ST(i) ST(i) = fsub ST(0), ST(i) ST(0) = fsubr ST(0), ST(i) ST(i) = fsubr ST(0), ST(i)

briefdescription.para: handleCompareFP - Handle FUCOM and FUCOMI instructions, which have two FP register arguments and no explicit destinations.
handleCondMovFP - Handle two address conditional move instructions.

detaileddescription.para: These instructions move a st(i) register to st(0) iff a condition is true. These instructions require that the first operand is at the top of the stack, but otherwise don't modify the stack at all.

briefdescription.para: handleSpecialFP - Handle special instructions which behave unlike other floating point instructions.

detaileddescription.para: This is primarily intended for use by pseudo instructions.
